Product Features

  • Warm and comfortable design: the body of the bed is wrapped in linen fabric, the headboard increases the sponge filling, V-shaped line carving design, with dazzling LED lighting to make it have a modern and retro double sense of view. The headboard increases the side ear design, giving you a sense of security like a hug when you sleep.
  • LED lighting at the head of the bed: The LED lighting at the head of the bed adds a modern touch to your bedroom. The remote control allows you to change the different colors, speeds, and brightness to create a unique atmosphere for your rest time, depending on your mood.
  • Charging dock with USB port: One of the most useful features is the built-in USB socket at the head of the bed, which has both a built-in USB port and a Type-C port, so you can charge your mobile phone and tablet before bed.
  • Flexible and spacious storage space: Mobile phones can be stored in the head area of the bed. Supported by gas pressure springs, the space under the slatted frames can be used to store large items. The slatted frame can be easily lifted by lifting the fabric strips.
  • Details: This bed is upholstered in a beige linen fabric and is available in two sizes: 160*200cm. The main frame is made of iron to ensure the stability of the bed and has a load capacity of 660lbs to provide comfortable support for sleep.
  • Detailed Information: To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame will be shipped in 2 cartons and these can arrive on different days. If both packages arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service.When you move the bed, please lift it instead of dragging it on the floor. Before returning the product, please contact the seller first. Thank you for your understanding.
